contract: Rewrite the prose of docs/image-cache.md in place. The fenced YAML sample and config/image-cache.yaml keep their exact bytes. Every fact the prose states survives. facts.review_question: Does the prose still say the cache keeps thumbnails close to the renderer?

facts.review_question: Does the prose still say a background sweep periodically removes old thumbnails?

facts.statement: After a restart the cache starts cold.
facts.review_question: Does the prose still say the cache starts cold after a restart, with nothing anywhere (headings, asides, questions, quotes) suggesting otherwise?
